Here's when you'll see and hear NASA's Artemis II launch tonight across Florida Updated: 3:57 PM EDT Apr 1, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ It's launch day on the Space Coast, with four astronauts expected to lift off from Kennedy Space Center after 6 p.m. More than 400,000 people are expected to be in Brevard County for the Moon flyby launch. For those who can't make it out to the coast, the launch will likely be visible across the state. "We'll also be monitoring those clouds to see where things may be obstructed," he said. When you might hear the launchMainolfi says, depending on the wind and humidity, the "roar" of Artemis may be heard as far as 45 miles inland from the launch pad. "This isn't a sonic boom as a rocket isn't returning back to EARTH, but the rolling sound that is being produced from all of the rocket thrust," Mainolfi said.
